### Basking in the Perfections of Jesus: Praying through Hebrews 1:1-3 (ESV)
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/basking-in-the-perfections-of-jesus-praying-through-hebrews-11-3-esv/
Passage: Hebrews 1:1-3
Points:
- Praise is offered to God for speaking and revealing Himself through the Scriptures.
- All biblical promises find their true meaning and fulfillment in Jesus Christ.
- Through the gospel, believers are united with Christ and made co-heirs with Him.
- Jesus shares the Father's exact nature and sustains the entire universe by His power.
- The finished sacrifice of Jesus provides enduring peace and assurance of God's unchanging love.

### Plumbing the Depths of His Person
Author: R.C. Sproul
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/plumbing-depths-his-person
Passage: Hebrews 1:3
Points:
- Seeking to understand Jesus brings believers directly into the deep mystery of God's essence.
- Unlike Moses who merely reflected God's glory, Christ is the very brightness of divine glory.
- The Old Testament radiant cloud pointed toward the supreme glory revealed in the Son.
- Divine glory displays the consuming holiness and inaccessible light of God.
- Through the gospel, Jesus graciously imparts His divine glory to His people.

### The Final Word
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/final-word
Passage: Hebrews 1:1-2
Points:
- Hebrews opens by establishing the unqualified supremacy of Jesus Christ above the prophets.
- God previously communicated His truth in various ways and stages throughout history.
- In these last days, God has spoken decisively and fully through His Son.
- While prophets and the Son both bring divine revelation, Christ provides God's final word.
- Believers must look to Christ as the complete revelation rather than seeking new revelations.
